changelog: Presets: players save their selection look (scene, time, weather, filter, camera, pose and music) and pick one to load every time the menu opens
Up to 5 presets per player (Config.Presets), stored on the player's PC, no database changes
BUPA Spawn Selector support: Integrations.Spawn = 'auto' finds it, 'bupa' works as a short name
Removed install/bupa_multicharacter.sql, tables are created on start
